Daily NVIDIA stock prices

nvda.Rd

Daily prices and trading volume for NVIDIA Corporation stocks on Nasdaq, with moving averages and volatility calculated from them.

Usage

nvda

Format

A data frame with 6,958 rows and 10 columns. Each row is one trading day:

date

Trading date

open, high, low, close

Opening, highest, lowest and closing price in US dollars, adjusted for share splits

volume

Number of shares traded, adjusted for share splits

daily_return_pct

Percentage change in the closing price from the previous trading day; NA on the first day

sma_20, sma_50

Average closing price over the last 20 and 50 trading days; NA until enough days are available

volatility_20_pct

Annualised volatility (%): the standard deviation of the last 20 daily log returns multiplied by \(\sqrt{252}\); NA for the first 20 days

Source

Kaggle dataset "Nvidia Historical Stock Data" by Muhammad Ibrahim Shahrukh, https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/muhammadishahrukh/nvidia-historical-stock-data?resource=download, licence CC BY-SA 4.0. Prices originally from Yahoo Finance.

Details

Past prices are divided down to account for NVIDIA's share splits, so a 1999 price of $0.04 equals about $18 paid at the time. There are no rows for weekends or US market holidays. The data run from 22 January 1999 to 21 September 2026.
